$comment: Source of truth for PixelLab sprite generation (base sprites + south idle/attack animations). Process rules live in PixelLab.md. Base sprites and object candidates are ALWAYS approved/selected by the user before animating.

animation.idleSeamlessLoopSentence: The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.

enemies.name: Mummy
enemies.description: Ancient desert mummy, an undead humanoid wrapped head to toe in tattered sand-stained linen bandages, loose frayed strips hanging from its arms and waist. Dried grey-brown desiccated skin shows through gaps in the wrappings. Two glowing amber eyes shine from within the bandaged face. Remnants of a faded golden funerary collar around the neck and a torn pharaonic headcloth. Hunched, menacing stance with arms half-raised, attacking with clawed bandaged hands, no weapons.
enemies.idle: A hunched undead mummy wrapped in tattered sand-stained linen bandages with a blue-and-gold pharaonic headcloth, clawed hands half-raised. It sways slowly in place, chest rising and falling as it breathes, loose bandage strips swinging gently. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The hunched mummy in tattered linen bandages with a blue-and-gold pharaonic headcloth attacks — it rears back gathering itself, then lunges toward the camera slashing downward with both clawed bandaged hands, then recoils back into its hunched ready stance.
enemies.$note: Base + animations approved; frames integrated into public/assets/characters/mummy + src manifest + masks.

enemies.name: Scarab Swarm
enemies.description: A dense swarm of glossy black-and-gold scarab beetles crawling over each other in a loose ball, iridescent green shimmer on their carapaces, tiny legs and clicking mandibles visible at the edges, a few beetles skittering slightly apart from the mass.
enemies.idle: A dense ball of glossy black-and-gold scarab beetles crawling over each other, iridescent shimmer rippling across the mass, single beetles briefly skittering out and back in. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The swarm of glossy black-and-gold scarabs attacks — the mass compresses tightly, then bursts forward toward the camera in a scattering wave of beetles, then pulls back together into the crawling ball.
enemies.$note: user rejected all candidates, enemy removed from Act II roster

enemies.name: Carrion Vulture
enemies.description: A mangy desert vulture with a bald wrinkled pink neck, dusty dark-brown ragged feathers with gaps and broken plumes, a long hooked yellowed beak, hunched posture with wings half-folded, facing the camera.
enemies.idle: A mangy hunched vulture with a bald pink neck and ragged dark-brown feathers, shifting its weight from foot to foot, head twitching as it looks around, feathers ruffling slightly. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The ragged brown vulture with a bald pink neck attacks — it spreads its tattered wings wide, lunges its hooked beak toward the camera with a sharp pecking strike, then folds back into its hunched stance.

enemies.name: Sand Cobra
enemies.description: A giant desert cobra rearing upright, sand-yellow scales with dark brown diamond markings down its back, wide flared hood with an eye-like pattern, fangs bared, coiled lower body resting on the sand, facing the camera.
enemies.idle: A giant sand-yellow cobra with a flared patterned hood, reared upright on its coiled body, swaying slowly side to side, forked tongue flicking out. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The giant sand-yellow cobra with flared hood attacks — it draws its head back coiling tension, then strikes forward toward the camera with bared fangs, then recoils back into its upright swaying posture.

enemies.name: Jackal Raider
enemies.description: A jackal-headed desert raider with tan fur, black-tipped ears and muzzle, wearing a ragged sand-colored wrap, leather chest straps and a bronze shoulder plate, holding a curved khopesh sword in one hand, gold bangles on the wrists, standing in a ready fighting stance.
enemies.idle: A jackal-headed raider with tan fur and a bronze shoulder plate, holding a curved khopesh sword, standing in a ready stance. It breathes steadily, ears twitching, the sword hand shifting slightly. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The jackal-headed raider with the curved khopesh sword attacks — it draws the blade back across its body, then slashes it in a wide arc toward the camera, then returns to its ready fighting stance.

enemies.name: Skeleton Archer
enemies.description: An undead skeleton archer with yellowed cracked bones, wearing scraps of rotted leather armor and a torn hood, holding a weathered recurve bow, a quiver of crooked arrows on its back, glowing pale-blue points of light in its empty eye sockets.
enemies.idle: A yellowed skeleton archer in a torn hood holding a weathered recurve bow, standing watchfully. Its ribcage shifts subtly, the bow arm sways, pale-blue eye lights flicker in empty sockets. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The hooded skeleton archer attacks — it nocks a crooked arrow, draws the weathered bow fully back, then releases the arrow toward the camera and lowers the bow back to rest.

enemies.name: Sand Elemental
enemies.description: A living whirlwind of sand — a swirling column of ochre dust forming a vaguely humanoid torso, two massive fists of compacted sandstone, floating rock chunks orbiting inside the vortex, a glowing amber core where a face would be.
enemies.idle: A swirling column of ochre sand with a humanoid torso, sandstone fists and a glowing amber core, dust spiraling continuously upward, small rocks orbiting the vortex. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The swirling sand elemental with sandstone fists attacks — it gathers the vortex tighter, then slams both massive stone fists forward toward the camera in a burst of sand, then disperses back into its swirling column.

enemies.name: Tomb Colossus
enemies.description: A colossal ancient tomb guardian statue come to life, carved from sandstone with deep cracks glowing faint turquoise, gold hieroglyphs engraved across its chest and arms, a pharaonic stone headdress, massive square fists, small fragments of stone hovering at its broken joints.
enemies.idle: A colossal sandstone tomb guardian with glowing turquoise cracks and gold hieroglyphs, standing massive and still. It breathes with a slow grinding heave, stone fragments drifting at its joints, cracks pulsing faintly. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The colossal sandstone guardian with glowing turquoise cracks attacks — it raises one massive square fist high overhead, then smashes it down toward the camera with a heavy impact, then grinds slowly back upright.

enemies.name: Frost Wolf
enemies.description: A large arctic dire wolf facing the viewer head-on, front view with chest and head pointed straight at the camera, all four legs planted wide and visible. Thick layered fur in rich ramps of white, pale blue and grey-blue with detailed fur clumps and strong cold rim light. Jagged translucent ice spikes grow along its spine and shoulders, frost mist curls from its open jaws, glowing ice-blue eyes stare directly at the viewer, high-contrast detailed pixel art.
enemies.idle: A large white-and-blue arctic wolf with ice spikes along its spine, standing alert. It breathes visibly with frost mist curling from its jaws, shifting its paws, tail swaying slowly. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The white arctic wolf with ice spikes on its spine attacks — it crouches low gathering power, then lunges toward the camera with jaws snapping in a frosty bite, then springs back into its alert stance.

enemies.name: Snow Harpy
enemies.description: A pale snow harpy with a gaunt bluish-white female upper body, wild white hair rimed with frost, large frost-covered feathered wings spread half-open, bird-like taloned legs, tattered icy feathers, hovering slightly above the ground, facing the camera.
enemies.idle: A pale snow harpy with frost-white wings half-spread, hovering gently, wings beating slowly, white hair and icy feathers drifting in the cold air. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The pale snow harpy with frosted wings attacks — she rises with a sharp wingbeat, then dives toward the camera slashing with bird-like talons, then flaps back up into her hovering pose.

enemies.name: Frozen Revenant
enemies.description: An undead frozen warrior encased in rime — pale blue-grey dead skin, frost-covered dented iron armor and chainmail, icicles hanging from its pauldrons and helmet rim, wielding a cracked longsword sheathed in ice, glowing cold white eyes.
enemies.idle: A frozen undead warrior in frost-covered dented iron armor holding an ice-sheathed longsword, standing rigid. It sways stiffly, cold white eyes pulsing, frost vapor drifting off its shoulders. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The frozen warrior in rimed iron armor attacks — it heaves the ice-sheathed longsword up over its shoulder, then swings it down toward the camera in a heavy frozen arc, then stiffly resets its guard.

enemies.name: Yeti
enemies.description: A massive yeti with shaggy white fur, exposed slate-blue skin on the face and chest, long powerful arms with black claws reaching below its knees, a heavy hunched posture, small cold eyes and a large fanged mouth, frost clinging to its shoulders.
enemies.idle: A massive shaggy white yeti with slate-blue face and long clawed arms, hunched and breathing heavily, shoulders rising and falling, fur swaying, occasionally flexing its claws. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The massive white yeti with long clawed arms attacks — it rears up beating its chest once, then swings both clawed arms down toward the camera in a crushing double blow, then drops back into its hunched posture.

enemies.name: Ice Elemental
enemies.description: A levitating cluster of jagged translucent ice crystals arranged in a vaguely humanoid form, a bright frozen core of pale blue light glowing in the center, orbiting shards of ice and drifting snow particles, sharp crystalline limbs, facing the camera.
enemies.idle: A levitating humanoid cluster of translucent ice crystals with a glowing pale-blue core, shards slowly orbiting the body, snow particles drifting, the core pulsing gently. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The crystalline ice elemental with the glowing blue core attacks — its orbiting shards gather and sharpen, then fire forward toward the camera in a burst of ice splinters, then new shards reform around its body.

enemies.name: Winter Witch
enemies.description: A pale winter witch with frost-white skin and long silver hair, wearing a flowing dark-blue hooded cloak edged with white fur and ice crystals, holding a gnarled wooden staff topped with a large glowing icicle, faint snowflakes drifting around her.
enemies.idle: A pale witch in a dark-blue fur-edged cloak holding a staff topped with a glowing icicle, standing calmly. Her cloak and silver hair drift in the cold wind, the icicle pulsing with light, snowflakes falling around her. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The pale witch with the icicle-topped staff attacks — she raises the staff high as the icicle flares bright, then thrusts it forward launching a shard of ice toward the camera, then lowers the staff back to her side.

enemies.name: Frost Drake
enemies.description: An ice drake — a wyvern-like dragon with two legs and large wings, pale blue scales with white crystalline ridges, translucent ice spines along its back and tail, wings of stretched frost-veined membrane, a wisp of freezing mist at its nostrils, facing the camera with wings half-spread.
enemies.idle: A pale blue wyvern-like ice drake with frost-veined wings half-spread, breathing slowly with freezing mist curling from its nostrils, wings flexing gently, tail swaying. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The pale blue ice drake attacks — it rears its head back inhaling deeply, then blasts a cone of freezing mist and ice shards toward the camera, then settles back with wings half-spread.

enemies.name: Glacier Colossus
enemies.description: A towering colossus made of glacial ice, translucent blue-white body with dark boulders and gravel frozen inside its chest and shoulders, deep cracks glowing cold cyan, massive blocky fists of compacted ice, jagged crown-like ice spikes on its head.
enemies.idle: A towering translucent glacier colossus with boulders frozen inside its body and glowing cyan cracks, standing immense and slow. It heaves with a grinding breath, ice creaking, cracks pulsing with cold light. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The towering glacier colossus attacks — it draws both massive ice fists back, then slams them together toward the camera in a crushing blow that scatters ice shards, then grinds back upright.

enemies.name: Imp
enemies.description: A wiry sinister imp with dark crimson-to-maroon leathery skin rendered in rich shading ramps, lean sinewy limbs and a hunched predatory crouch. Long swept-back black horns, ragged pointed ears, jagged tattered bat wings half-raised behind its back, a long whip-thin tail with a barbed spade tip. Furnace-yellow glowing eyes, a wicked grin full of needle teeth, long hooked claws, small embers and heat glow rising from its skin.
enemies.idle: A small crimson imp with curved horns and folded bat wings, crouched playfully, tail flicking side to side, wings twitching, grinning with glowing yellow eyes. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The small crimson imp with bat wings attacks — it conjures a small flickering fireball between its claws, then hurls it toward the camera with a hop, then lands back in its crouched grinning stance.

enemies.name: Hellhound
enemies.description: A monstrous black hellhound facing the viewer head-on, front view with chest and head pointed straight at the camera, all four legs planted wide and visible. Jet-black fur in rich dark ramps of charcoal and blue-black with strong orange rim light from below. Cracks of molten lava glow across its chest and front legs, a flickering mane of orange fire frames its head and shoulders. Glowing ember eyes stare directly at the viewer, bared fangs, high-contrast detailed pixel art.
enemies.idle: A monstrous black hellhound with glowing lava-vein cracks and a burning fiery mane, standing in a predatory stance. Its flame mane flickers continuously, ember eyes glowing, muscles shifting as it breathes. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The black hellhound with the burning mane attacks — it crouches low with flaring flames, then lunges toward the camera with a snapping bite trailing fire, then pulls back into its predatory stance.
enemies.styleImages: approved v3 character sprite resized to <=128px, color-quantized (see PixelLab.md quadruped note)

enemies.name: Shadow Fiend
enemies.description: A shapeless fiend of living shadow — a swirling mass of black smoke forming a hooded silhouette torso, two long shadowy arms ending in elongated claws, piercing white glowing eyes with no other facial features, dark wisps trailing off its form, facing the camera.
enemies.idle: A hooded silhouette of living black smoke with long clawed arms and glowing white eyes, its form rippling and wisping continuously, edges dissolving and reforming. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The smoky shadow fiend with glowing white eyes attacks — it condenses into a darker denser mass, then whips both elongated shadow claws forward toward the camera in a slashing cross, then dissolves back into its rippling form.

enemies.name: Bone Colossus
enemies.description: A hulking colossus stitched together from hundreds of bones — a torso of interlocked ribcages and skulls, arms made of fused femurs ending in claw-like bone shards, a horned oversized skull head missing its lower jaw, a sickly green necrotic glow pulsing between the bones.
enemies.idle: A hulking colossus built from interlocked ribcages, skulls and fused femur arms, glowing sickly green between the bones, looming and swaying heavily, loose bones rattling and shifting. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The bone colossus with fused femur arms attacks — it rears back with a rattling shudder, then sweeps a massive bone-shard claw toward the camera in a wide crushing arc, then settles back into its looming sway.

enemies.name: Blade Demoness
enemies.description: A slender demoness with dark crimson skin, both forearms replaced by long curved obsidian blades, swept-back black horns, long dark hair, segmented dark armor plates on her torso and legs, a whip-like tail, glowing violet eyes, standing in an elegant fighting stance.
enemies.idle: A slender crimson demoness with obsidian blade forearms and swept-back horns, standing in an elegant fighting stance, blades lowered, tail swaying slowly, hair drifting, violet eyes glowing. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The crimson demoness with obsidian blade forearms attacks — she spins once gathering momentum, then slashes both curved blades toward the camera in a scissoring cross-cut, then flows back into her elegant stance.

enemies.name: Demon Lord
enemies.description: A towering demon lord with deep red muscular skin, huge ram-like black horns, large leathery bat wings folded behind his back, ornate black-and-gold armor plates on his shoulders and waist, a massive flaming greatsword held point-down in one hand, cloven hooves, burning orange eyes, embers rising around him.
enemies.idle: A towering red demon lord with ram horns and folded bat wings, resting a massive flaming greatsword point-down, breathing slowly, embers rising, the sword's flames flickering steadily. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
enemies.attack: The towering demon lord with ram horns attacks — he hoists the massive flaming greatsword overhead with both hands, then cleaves it down toward the camera in a fiery eruption, then plants it back point-down.

backfill.attack: The large brown bear attacks — it rears up on its hind legs, then swipes a heavy front paw with claws toward the camera, then drops back onto all fours.

backfill.idle: A robed fire mage with glowing ember accents, standing with hands loosely at the sides, robes swaying gently, small flames flickering around the palms. The animation forms a seamless loop — the first and last frames are visually identical in pose and position.
